structure.unit: Statewide Emergency Medical Services System and Services

law.catch_line: Penalty for disobeying emergency medical services agency chief or other officer in command
law.text: If any person at a fire or medical emergency refuses or neglects to obey any order duly given by the individual having command of the incident in accordance with § 32.1-111.14:5 or 32.1-111.14:6, he shall, upon conviction of such offense, be fined not to exceed $100.
